events: Cup game ends; Briar invites Kaze to room, kissing and talking followed by shared sleep. Room keys returned in morning.
Orren identifies next market town as Lask and western gate meeting point; Samira uses paid seat, actual departure occurs.
Returning quarry foreman recognizes Kaze, seeks wagons and complains of damage; introduces present Kratos through report of meeting on road, gives firsthand Baldur-escape testimony.
Kaze and Kratos exchange names. Kaze blocks passage and grabs shoulder, rejects attempt to disengage. Kratos moves away from bystanders, Kaze follows and punches him.

Destructive close fight in unused vineyard: strikes/grapples, axe/shield, living-sword defense, ballistic launches/rebounds, anchored chained blades, finite rage. Kaze deliberately trades shoulder cut for strike then heals.

Kratos attempts to leave, Kaze intercepts; Kratos states he killed Baldur after protection broke. Kaze asks how but receives no method. He voluntarily steps aside and mentions old quarry ridge. Kratos warns against following.
Kaze pays two silver toward broken trough. Vineyard damage remains unsettled. Kratos leaves alone. Kaze chooses market with Briar over pursuit.
Kaze carries Briar in one ballistic leap across fields, lands ahead of Orren wagon, sets her down after Samira teasing exchange. Journey continues, market not reached.
